title: World Junior Championships 2026 Selection Eligibility Announced
indian_angle: This circular outlines the eligibility criteria for Indian players aiming to represent the country at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: BAI has released the eligibility requirements for Indian badminton players to be considered for selection for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The new 3x15 scoring system will be implemented in all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, impacting junior player development in India.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues
indian_angle: The advisory warns Indian players, coaches, and officials against participating in or associating with unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments, safeguarding the sport's integrity in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued an advisory cautioning players, coaches, and officials against involvement in unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships not sanctioned by the national body.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament in Chennai
indian_angle: This tournament is a crucial event for senior Indian players to gain ranking points and showcase their talent on the national stage.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 is scheduled to take place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, 2026, attracting top senior players from across the country.

title: India Invites Expressions of Interest for BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: India has opened Expressions of Interest for organizing the BWF World Championships 2026, highlighting the nation's ambition to host a premier global badminton event.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has invited Expressions of Interest (EOI) from potential organizers for the BWF World Championships 2026, signaling India's bid to host the prestigious international tournament.
